prompt: The video begins with the viewer moving forward along a narrow stone pathway flanked by lush greenery and ancient stone walls, leading towards an old building partially covered in ivy. As the camera advances steadily, it captures the intricate textures of the moss-covered stones and the dense foliage that frames the path. The scene transitions smoothly as the viewer turns left, revealing a wider dirt trail bordered by trees and shrubs under a cloudy sky. The camera continues to move forward, panning slightly to showcase the natural surroundings, including the misty atmosphere that adds a layer of depth to the landscape. The viewer then approaches a set of stone steps leading up to another ivy-clad building, with the camera tilting upward to emphasize the height and detail of the stairs. After ascending the steps, the perspective shifts to reveal a panoramic view of the ocean, with the horizon shrouded in fog. The camera pans slowly from left to right, capturing the serene expanse of water and the distant shoreline, while the muted colors of the overcast day enhance the tranquil mood of the scene. Throughout the sequence, the camera maintains a steady pace, providing a continuous and immersive experience of the outdoor environment on Shengshan Island.
